2121034897808654431.zh_summary: Cisco Systems（$CSCO）因代理人工智能市場需求高漲、營收及利潤飆升而上調展望，據《華爾街日報》報道。

2121034881753113069.en_summary: Try to keep track of all the moves $RKLB is making. Quoted @RocketLab: All eight Rocket Lab-built Lightning platforms for @MDA_space and @Globalstar have passed initial on-orbit functional tests. Orbit raising is now underway.
2121034881753113069.zh_summary: 試圖追蹤 $RKLB 正在進行的所有動作。引用 @RocketLab：為 @MDA_space 及 @Globalstar 建造的全部八個 Rocket Lab Lightning 平台已通過初始在軌功能測試。軌道提升現正進行中。

2121034658385371472.en_summary: Jack Welch leaves GE Capital. Quoted report: Nvidia ($NVDA) is expected to slow its aggressive AI investment strategy following Jensen Huang's resignation, putting billions in startup funding and credit guarantees at risk, The Information reports.
2121034658385371472.zh_summary: Jack Welch 離開 GE Capital。引用報道：據 The Information 報道，在 Jensen Huang 辭職後，Nvidia（$NVDA）預計將放緩其積極的人工智能投資策略，使數十億美元的初創企業融資及信貸擔保面臨風險。

2121034000705753244.en_summary: One chart captures Nvidia’s historic day: $123bn worth of shares changed hands – a record. A colossal tug-of-war between bulls and bears. A buying opportunity for some. An escape route for others. $NVDA is Wall Street’s ultimate battleground.
2121034000705753244.zh_summary: 一張圖表捕捉了 Nvidia 的歷史性一天：$1230 億美元股份成交，創下紀錄。多空之間的巨大拉鋸。對一些人來說是買入機會，對另一些人來說是逃離路線。$NVDA 是華爾街的終極戰場。
